info.title: Mizaniya Pay Partner API
info.description: Sell Mizaniya Pay services from your own website or app: send your API key in the x-api-key header.

post.description: One route for every product: type selects the fields to send (mobile when omitted). The price is taken from your balance. clientRef is your own unique reference: sending the same clientRef again returns the original order instead of selling twice, so retry with it after a timeout. Most orders finish later: poll GET /orders/{id} for the outcome. Needs sell:create.

200.description: Order accepted. The same clientRef with the same body returns the same order (safe to retry); poll GET /orders/{id} for its outcome.

400.description: Bad request: the request is malformed or a value is invalid (see details.errors).

errors: type must be one of the following values: mobile, gift_card, esim

get.description: An open order is checked with the provider on each read, so polling this route is enough to see it finish. Mobile and gift card orders: read outcome; processing and verifying are still open, success, failed and cancelled are final, and failureCode says why one failed. eSIM orders are open while status is pending or provisioning. Needs orders:read.

get.summary: The card codes of a delivered gift card order

type.description: What to buy. Each type takes its own fields: mobile → operator, planCode, phoneNumber, amount; gift_card → productId, typeId, quantity; esim → packageId, quantity, days, customer.

clientRef.description: Caller-generated idempotency key, unique per account. Re-sending the same reference returns the original order.

amount.description: mobile only: face value in DZD; required for free-amount plans

typeId.description: gift_card only: the denomination, from GET /products/gift-cards/{productId}

quantity.description: gift_card and esim: number of cards or eSIMs (a gift card denomination states its own maxQuantity)

days.description: esim only: days, for unlimited plans

customer.description: esim only: send the QR code to this customer by email and/or SMS. Leave it out to deliver the QR code yourself from the order.
